description:
## Goal

Add a scenario-auditor rule that compares the declared tools in `api/tools/` against the runtime `/api/v1/tools` manifest. Drift fails.

## Expected Work

- New rule in `scenarios/scenario-auditor/api/rules/` that:
  - Discovers the scenario's `api/tools/` directory (if present).
  - Parses declared tool names/metadata from source.
  - Fetches `/api/v1/tools` from the running scenario.
  - Reports mismatches (declared-but-not-exposed, exposed-but-not-declared, field drift).
- The rule is informational (not a failure) for scenarios with no `api/tools/` — we are not forcing every scenario to expose tools.

## Acceptance

- Passes cleanly against the two migrated scenarios (`agent-manager`, `scenario-to-cloud`).
- Produces an actionable diff when intentionally broken.
name: tool-authoring-auditor-rule
title: Add scenario-auditor rule for tool declaration vs. runtime drift
